headline: 9 Bangladeshis killed in Kolkata hotel fire, 15 injured
summary: A devastating fire erupted at a residential hotel in Kolkata's New Market area, claiming the lives of nine Bangladeshi nationals. Fifteen others were rescued with burns and are currently receiving hospital treatment.
details: At least nine Bangladeshi nationals have died in a devastating fire at a residential hotel in Kolkata's New Market area. Another 15 people were rescued with burn injuries and admitted to the hospital.

The fire broke out early Wednesday morning on the third floor of the 'Shikhail' residential hotel on Free School Street. Local police and fire service personnel quickly arrived at the scene and launched rescue operations.
Among the deceased are two women and one child. The exact cause of this horrific blaze is still under investigation.
A case has been filed against the hotel owner, who has been absconding since the incident. Police have also conducted searches at his residence.

A case has been filed against the hotel owner, who has been absconding since the incident. Police have also conducted searches at his residence.

headline: BDT 15 crore Yaba consignment seized in Cumilla, 3 lakh pills found in Prado, 2 arrested
summary: Authorities in Cumilla have successfully intercepted a massive drug shipment, discovering 3 lakh Yaba pills hidden inside a Prado vehicle. The seized narcotics are estimated to be worth BDT 15 crore.
details: Law enforcement in Cumilla achieved a significant breakthrough in the fight against drug trafficking, seizing a massive consignment of Yaba pills. The operation led to the recovery of 300,000 Yaba tablets with an estimated street value of BDT 15 crore. Two individuals were also arrested in connection with the seizure.

The illicit drugs were reportedly found concealed within a Prado vehicle, indicating a sophisticated attempt to smuggle the narcotics. This incident highlights the ongoing challenges faced by authorities in curbing the flow of illegal substances into and across the country.

Yaba, a methamphetamine-based drug, remains a major concern in Bangladesh, with its widespread availability contributing to social and health issues. Law enforcement agencies continue to conduct regular operations to dismantle drug networks and bring perpetrators to justice.

The arrested individuals are currently undergoing interrogation to uncover further details about the drug network, its origins, and intended distribution channels. Investigations are ongoing to identify other potential accomplices involved in this large-scale smuggling operation.
